main.description: An explicitly published, owner-authored learning summary. This is not an issuer-verified achievement. Missing record means private or not yet published; consumers must not infer privacy from network errors.

visibility.description: A private tombstone contains no topics or activity. Writers must use swapRecord for every publication or withdrawal to prevent stale writes resurrecting withdrawn content.

publicationId.description: Unique nonce per publication/withdrawal. Prevents same-timestamp revision reuse.

savedSessions.description: Optional count of visible saved sessions on the publishing device; not proof of lesson completion or mastery.
